summary: Iteration 12 verification: 3 new UX features (greeting subtitle, 90-sec demo countdown badge, portal voice-note intros) + 5 security hardening controls (rate limits, message caps, payload caps, generic errors, CORS credentials off). Backend: 11/11 pytest pass (test_iteration12_security.py). Frontend: all 4 new UX/integration flows pass at 390x844 + judge-reset regression passes. No regressions detected.

acceptance_checks.check: POST /api/auth/demo rate limit → 429 within 10-12 rapid calls
POST /api/guardian/chat-once >20 rapid calls → 429 (with valid 200 reply first)
CORS Access-Control-Allow-Credentials NOT true (wildcard origin safety)
Fresh '/' → SKIP CINEMATIC → hub → [data-testid=guardian-subtitle] appears within ~5s showing 'GUARDIAN\nWelcome. I am your Guardian. Seven worlds, one presence. Let us begin.'
Hub → Open 90-sec judge demo → Start with Work → [data-testid=demo-timer-badge] appears with 'DEMO · 1:XX', counts down (1:28→1:25 in 2s), persists on /portal/work
Judge Reset ⟲ ([data-testid=judge-reset-btn]) with active demo badge → hard-navigates to '/', badge removed, entrance video replays muted-autoplay with advancing currentTime (2.03s)

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: in-memory sliding-window rate_limit() is single-process only. For horizontal scale, migrate to Redis-backed limiter. Acceptable for the current single-instance deployment.

server.py: Pydantic ChatIn already caps message length via Field(max_length=2000), so 422 fires BEFORE the limiter — confirmed empirically. This means oversized-message spam CAN bypass the chat rate budget; consider a payload-size middleware if that becomes a concern.
server.py: portal state 20KB cap is enforced AFTER auth but BEFORE db write via len(json.dumps(body.data)) — clean and cheap.
server.py: /api/guardian/portal-intro applies rate_limit BEFORE the 404 check — a scanner probing unknown portals still consumes the ttsline budget. Minor and by-design.

CORSMiddleware: allow_credentials=False with allow_origins=['*'] is the correct and safe combo for Bearer-token auth. Verified via OPTIONS preflight — response header omits Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true.

demo-timer.tsx (77 lines): clean context provider, DEMO_SECONDS=90 constant, auto-clears 4s past 0, tap-to-dismiss via Pressable with hitSlop=10 and accessibilityLabel. testID='demo-timer-badge' present.
guardian-tts.ts: web Audio() branch handles autoplay-blocked playback by deferring to first pointerdown — correct for the browser autoplay policy.
cinematic-hub.tsx: subtitle wrap uses pointerEvents:'none' via style prop (not JSX prop) — no RN-Web deprecation warning.
seed_data_creation: TestAuthDemoRateLimit creates a few demo users + sessions in Mongo (users collection) — expected and cheap. TestPortalStatePayloadCap writes a small portal_state doc against the pre-existing token's user. No other side effects.
